stage: question-first editorial draft before local candidate tables
independence: Author saw legacy and prior packet; not blind or independently validated. Fresh held-out probes must come from another reviewer.

questions.text: Does methane mean one molecule or a collection of the same kind?
questions.interpretation_seed: Molecular entity vs species ensemble vs classifier.

questions.text: Has a chemical change occurred or have materials only mixed?
When salt disappears into water, what material remains?
questions.interpretation_seed: Dissolution and solution rather than disappearance of matter.

questions.text: Are oil and water one phase after stirring?
Does a new solid in water mean it rained?
questions.interpretation_seed: Chemical precipitation distinct from meteorological precipitation.

questions.text: Can oxidation occur without adding oxygen?
questions.interpretation_seed: Electron loss/oxidation-state reading, not oxygen-only definition.

questions.text: Which molecule is attached to the surface rather than dissolved in the bulk?
How much of each species is present in this sample?
questions.interpretation_seed: Species-specific amount/concentration requires denominator and phase.

questions.text: Can equal masses of two substances contain different numbers of entities?
Is a material uniform for one constituent but patchy for another?
What starts and finishes a single reaction episode?
questions.interpretation_seed: Operational bounded event around dependent reaction process.

questions.text: Are the products different species or only a different physical state?
questions.interpretation_seed: Interconversion vs phase change may overlap; identify actual entities.

questions.text: Does adsorption always leave a molecule intact?
Does unknown chemical composition mean a new kind of substance?
questions.interpretation_seed: Unknown evidence is not chemical identity.

questions.text: Can a chemical classification code tell us how fast this reaction proceeds?
